title: 공군공중기동정찰사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Duties and Jurisdiction)
(1) The Air Force Air Mobility and Reconnaissance Command (hereinafter referred to as the "Command") shall take charge of matters concerning operations, training, and military administration for units subordinated or attached to the Command.
(2) The territorial jurisdiction of the Command over operations and training shall be determined by the Commander of Air Force Operations Command, and its territorial jurisdiction over military administration shall be determined by the Chief of Staff of the Air Force.
